name: bmi_idempotent_of_assoc_of_is_m_of_is_i
lines: h_assoc : ∀ (x y z : A), x * y * z = x * (y * z)
⊢ M * I * x = I * I * x

steps.tactic:
calc
  x * x = M * x := (hM x).symm
  _ = M * (I * x) := by rw [hI x]
  _ = (M * I) * x := (h_assoc M I x).symm
  _ = (I * I) * x := by rw [hM I]
  _ = I * (I * x) := (h_assoc I I x)
  _ = I * x := (hI (I * x))
  _ = x := hI x

x * x = M * x := (hM x).symm
  _ = M * (I * x) := by rw [hI x]
  _ = (M * I) * x := (h_assoc M I x).symm
  _ = (I * I) * x := by rw [hM I]
  _ = I * (I * x) := (h_assoc I I x)
  _ = I * x := (hI (I * x))
  _ = x := hI x
